subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Password Crackdown
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Password Crackdown.

hook.text: For years, Netflix looked the other way as 100 million people used borrowed passwords. Then they stopped.

buildup.text: In 2023, Netflix began cracking down on password sharing. Users had to verify their household or pay extra.

discovery.text: Wall Street expected a subscriber exodus. Instead, millions of freeloaders signed up for their own accounts.

twist.text: Netflix gained more subscribers in the crackdown quarter than any period in its history. The gamble paid off.

climax.text: The crackdown proved that streaming had become essential. People complained, but they didn't leave.

punchline.text: Netflix called the bluff and won.

quiz.question: What happened when Netflix cracked down on password sharing in 2023?
options: Netflix gained a record number of new subscribers
